rounds.q: How many teaspoons of added sugar does the average US adult eat a day?
rounds.why: Men average 19 teaspoons a day and women 15.
rounds.src: CDC, Get the Facts: Added Sugars (2017-2018 data)
rounds.fun: Seventeen teaspoons a day! Men stir in 19 and women 15.

rounds.q: How many pounds of ice cream does the average American eat in a year?
rounds.why: USDA counts 12 lbs of regular ice cream plus about 6 lbs of low-fat and nonfat per person.
rounds.src: USDA Economic Research Service, Dairy Data: per capita consumption (2024 data)
rounds.fun: Eighteen pounds each! That is 12 of regular ice cream plus about 6 of low-fat and nonfat.

rounds.q: How many cocoa beans does it take to make one pound of chocolate?
rounds.why: Cocoa beans were once so highly valued that they were used as money until the 1800s.
rounds.src: Rainforest Alliance, Chocolate: The Journey From Beans to Bar (read 2026)
rounds.fun: About 400 beans in every pound! Cocoa beans were even used as money until the 1800s.

rounds.q: By US rules, milk chocolate must be at least what % ground cocoa beans?
rounds.why: The rule calls it chocolate liquor. Milk chocolate must also be at least 12% milk solids.
rounds.src: US FDA, Code of Federal Regulations 21 CFR 163.130 (current 2026)
rounds.fun: Just 10% ground cocoa beans makes the cut. The rule asks for even more milk solids, 12%!

rounds.q: How many miles do bees fly in all to make one pound of honey?
rounds.why: Along the way they tap about 2 million flowers, 50 to 100 of them on each trip.
rounds.src: National Honey Board, Honey Trivia press kit (read 2026)
rounds.fun: Over 55,000 miles and 2 million flowers for one pound of honey. That is one busy hive!
